Following Elon Musk’s claims this week that he is “not MAGA,” “Late Night” host Seth Meyers hit the billionaire with an instant fact check that recounted much of his history in the Trump administration.

While doing a virtual appearance at a New York Times summit this week, Musk expressed regret about donating nearly $500 million to GOP candidates during the midterm elections.

“I’m not MAGA,” Musk said. “Well, at least I’m not like, I’m not sure what MAGA means, but I don’t think I’m like, if that means sort of blind adherence to a set of policies by the Republican Party, then I certainly don’t have that.”

“I’m sorry, you’re not MAGA? But you said this,” Meyers said before playing a clip of Musk at a Trump rally in 2024 saying that he’s “not just MAGA,” he’s “dark gothic MAGA.”

The “Late Night” host then compared Musk’s statement to if he said he sawed wood by hand before playing the infamous clip of the billionaire at the Conservative Political Action Conference wielding a chainsaw.

“You spent nearly half a billion on MAGA candidates. You spoke at the inauguration. You campaigned with Trump,” Meyers said.

Meyers added that Musk was at the White House so much during the early days of President Donald Trump’s second term that he was “basically their Kramer.”
